pokedexEntries.su: Its head sports an altered form of whiskers made of metal. When in communication with its comrades, its whiskers wobble to and fro.

pokedexEntries.mo: Its golden hairs function as sensors. It pokes them out of its burrow to monitor its surroundings.

pokedexEntries.us: Although it’s powerful enough to dig right through volcanic rock, it doesn’t allow itself to be seen very often.

pokedexEntries.um: The need to dig through volcanic rock in the ground has made them more powerful than the Diglett of other regions.

pokedexEntries.lgpe: After living in soil with high iron content for some time, three steel whiskers sprouted from the top of its head.

pokedexEntries.sw: The metal-rich geology of this Pokémon’s habitat caused it to develop steel whiskers on its head.

pokedexEntries.sh: Its three hairs change shape depending on Diglett’s mood. They’re a useful communication tool among these Pokémon.
